message.reasoning:
I need to decide whether to accept, reject, or counter the trade offer from player p1.

I am p4 with $319 and a complete yellow set. The offer gives me $100, BOARDWALK, and READING_RAILROAD for NEW_YORK_AVENUE. Accepting would complete p1's orange set.

Accepting would give me a dark blue monopoly, but Boardwalk is mortgaged. The bigger concern is that p1 would have $330 and could mortgage three railroads, since Reading is now theirs.

Three railroads mortgage for $300. p1 could build orange immediately. That set is more dangerous than dark blue because it is landed on more often.

Unmortgaging Boardwalk costs $220. After that I would have only $199. Dark blue houses cost $200 each. I cannot build a house and stay solvent. Light-blue hotels can hit me for $550 or $600.

The Reading RR is not worth giving up the orange set. I will reject this offer. I cannot counter with New York Avenue, Park Place, or the yellow set.

A counter without New York Avenue would be useless. I considered demanding all of p1's cash and railroads, but even that would still hand them the orange set and enough money to build it immediately.

A fair counter would still lose. Orange is landed on more often, and p1 has enough liquidity to build it immediately.

p3 leads with light blue hotels and $1881 cash. p1 claims two of us must build to stop p3, but giving p1 orange makes them the second threat. They could bankrupt me before I bankrupt p3.

I will reject the trade. I considered selling my yellow set to p2, but that would give them a buildable set and utilities, which is too risky.

I checked p3's holdings. They lack a green monopoly and own only light blue, red, and brown properties. I cannot force p1 to unmortgage Boardwalk in the trade schema. I am now calculating a counter that requests more cash so I can unmortgage Boardwalk and build.

A counter demanding Boardwalk and $400 cash for New York Avenue would still leave p1 with enough money to build orange. I would have only about $299 after unmortgaging Boardwalk, which is not enough to cover a light-blue hotel hit. I cannot waste this exchange on an offer they will reject.
